title: OP-Print: Tracing Membership Imprints in On-Policy Self-Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2610.31616v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: On-policy distillation has been widely adopted for alleviating the distribution mismatch of off-policy distillation. Self-distillation further removes the need for an external teacher by using the student's own outputs, enhanced with extra context or demonstrations, as supervision. This teacher-free design makes on-policy self-distillation practical, yet its privacy risks remain largely unexplored. In particular, using two coupled views of the same training example may strengthen its memorization. Motivated by this, we present the first study of membership inference attacks against on-policy self-distillation. We investigate both gray-box and black-box threat models and propose a unified attack framework, named OP-Print. OP-Print builds on our finding that the supervision imprint in on-policy self-distillation is sparse and structured, concentrating on uncertainty-sensitive correction sites rather than across the entire rollout. translated_title: OP-Print：追踪在线策略自蒸馏中的成员印记
translated_abstract: 在线策略蒸馏已被广泛用于缓解离线策略蒸馏中的分布不匹配问题。自蒸馏则进一步通过使用学生模型自身的输出（辅以额外上下文或演示示例）作为监督，从而免除了对外部教师模型的需求。这种无教师的设计使在线策略自蒸馏变得实用，但其隐私风险在很大程度上仍未被探索。尤其是，对同一训练样本使用两个耦合视图可能会加强模型对该样本的记忆。受此启发，我们开展了首个针对在线策略自蒸馏的成员推断攻击研究。我们研究了灰盒与黑盒两种威胁模型，并提出了一个统一的攻击框架，命名为 OP-Print。OP-Print 建立在我们的一个发现之上：在线策略自蒸馏中的监督印记是稀疏且有结构的，集中于对不确定性敏感的修正位点，而非遍布整个采样序列。利用这一特性……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文首次研究了针对在线策略自蒸馏的成员推断攻击，发现其监督印记稀疏且集中于不确定性敏感的修正位点，并据此提出了统一的攻击框架 OP-Print，在灰盒和黑盒威胁模型下均能有效识别训练成员。
en_tdlr: We present the first study of membership inference attacks against on-policy self-distillation, proposing a unified attack framework, OP-Print, which exploits the finding that supervision imprints are sparse and structured, concentrating on uncertainty-sensitive correction sites rather than across the entire rollout.
